ko: 나의 사랑 너는 어여쁘고 참 귀하다
en: My love, you are precious and adored in my sight
You are more beloved than any jewel
Even when you fail me I have loved you always with my unfailing love and I have come to you just to be with you

ko: 주의 사랑 이 사랑은 결코 변치 않아
en: Your love, abiding love never changes
Your care is present in all seasons
Here the grass withers and all the flowers fade
But Your word remains You make no mistakes, I look to You, my Lord
Let Your kingdom come and Your will come into my life and be done I want to know Your, I want to see Your, Lord, my God
Grant me strength to live in holiness and live a life of faith without fear Lord, You are my God, I will sing of Your perfect love
Things Jesus planned through us We wait for the work He'll do through you
